command: pre-registration of the C1 grammar test

metrics.criterion: C1 holds at a level if recall >= 0.9 (events within +-5 frames of a label change) AND precision >= 0.5 (label changes within +-5 frames of an event) AND both exceed random change points of the same count per demo (100 draws)
metrics.plan: docs/PLAN_TRANSFER.md C1: the coarse prototype levels give a task's phase grammar (never tested separately)
metrics.reading: the grammar = the coarse phases; the binding (WHICH object, where) comes from the scene, not from prototypes
metrics.test: offline on the 50 stream-pool demos: every frame's chunk labelled at each coarse level of the 40-task tree (r19's basin rule); the label sequence's change points vs the v2 cut's events (the close before the manipulated object moves; the first release after; gripper events for demos that move no object)
